summary: Show a file or link to the owner through agent Tether.

help:
Usage: show [OPTIONS] {target}

  Show a file or link to the owner through the agent Tether instance.

Arguments:
  target  HTTP(S) URL or file path  [required]

Options:
  --title <str>         Notification title (up to 120 plain-text characters)
  --install-completion  Install completion for the current shell.
  --show-completion     Show completion for the current shell, to copy it or
                        customize the installation.
  --help                Show this message and exit.

usage.when: hand a file or HTTP(S) link to the owner
precautions: Files are copied into the agent exchange; the owner apps receive show.requested.
